players.product: Power Systems division: backup engines and gas engines for prime power at data centres; next-generation engine to replace the Series 4000, targeting the data centre market with increased power density (launch 2028)

quarterly_data.quarter: Rolls-Royce press release: Early recognition, better support: Rolls-Royce is expanding (09-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Rolls-Royce commissioned a new Remote Monitoring Centre in Arcola, Italy, for vessels fitted with mtu propulsion systems and for power generation plants (initially monitoring marine and yacht applications), its first outside Berlin and the starting point of a global roll-out, with Remote Monitoring Hubs to be established in future; the service runs on the mtu Go platform, and Italian ferry operator Liberty Lines and Italian shipyard Overmarine are already using it.
